sections.description:
MARTIAL LAW ORDER
MARTIAL LAW ORDERS
By
MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATOR ZONE `B'
No.
104
[17th
December 196 , Gazette of West
Pakistan,
Extraordinary, 21 st December 1961]
Whereas it is expedient in the
public interest to make recoveries of certain Government dues outstanding against
defaulters ;
Therefore, I, Lieut.-General Bakhtiar Rana, SQA, PAC, Martial
Law Administrator, Zone `B' hereby order
1, (a) Whoever fails to pay Government
dues outstanding against him on account of leases of land and contracts of
Forest produce obtained from Forests Department, purchase of seed, implements
and fertilizers from the Agriculture Department or hire charges of agricultural
machinery hired from the Agriculture Department, within one month of the issue
of a Notice of demand by a Divisional Forest Officer/Deputy Director of
Agriculture/ Superintending Engineer, Agriculture, shall be liable to
punishment under CMLA Reg. No. 16
The service of
Notice shall be deemed to have been adequately made if a copy of the Notice is
sent by registered post acknowledgment due at the last known address of the
defaulter and is pasted at the door of the house of the defaulter and is
published in a daily paper having circulation in area where the Defaulter
r--sides.
The arrears outstanding against
such person shall be recovered as if they were arrears of land revenue,
notwithstanding the fact that the defaulter has been punished under CMLA Reg.
No 16.
2 No provision of this order
shall be called in question in any Court including the High Court and Supreme
Court or before any authority. No suit or legal proceedings shall lie against
Government or any person in respect of anything done in good faith intended or
purported to have been done in relation to any proceedings under this order.
3. Notwithstanding anything to
the contrary contained in any law, order of decree of any Court or the
authority or any contract deed or other documents the provision of this order
will have immediate effect.
